accepted.reason: Classics Reborn reimagines the old TaC arsenal with revised models, animations and unusual action variants. Check the exact TaCZ and Arcana requirements of the chosen file.
accepted.access: Free public release; optional Afdian support

accepted.reason: ARIPS combines creator-designed and real-world-inspired firearms with a survival-oriented content-pack structure. A substantial omitted gun-content family, not an attachment-only expansion.
BlueArchive FPS Pack JP offers distinctive paired weapons, large energy weapons and game-inspired gun handling. Decorative vehicles in its gallery are not promised as usable vehicles.
Lavender: WWI Beneath the Wire explores early automatic, experimental and heavy firearm silhouettes rather than another modern rifle collection.
Delta Force: Operations & Warfare combines creator-authored gun models with an explicitly described modern tactical roster.
accepted.access: Free public release; regional paid beta
accepted.caution: The creator restricts paid beta participation to mainland China. The public released pack is free.

accepted.reason: Warsaw Pack draws from Battlefield 4, including a creator-described airburst launcher, burst-fire rifle and railgun. Optional support mods affect some features.
Relics & Antiques focuses on historical firearms and distinctive reload/action references, with creator-described models and historical research.
Forgotten Guns supplies uncommon firearm designs such as the Owen, MAS-38, Uru, Bren and Thorpe EM-1. Its unusual silhouettes make it more useful than a generic rifle variant pack.
Disassembly Pack mixes Murder Drones-inspired and other fictional gun designs, giving AoA-style energy weapons a different visual vocabulary.
accepted.caution: Check the creator's TaCZ version and Endless Ammo dependency before using a particular release.

accepted.reason: Devil May Cry Legacy Pack provides recognizable fictional handguns and heavy weapons, including Ebony & Ivory-style presentation. Retained as an older design reference, not claimed as a new release.
Machina is a focused Team Fortress 2 / Deus Ex-inspired railgun reference with a specific model and reload identity, rather than an oversized general-purpose gun collection.
Nakara Weapon Pack offers a coherent fictional science-fiction arsenal from its creator's world, with a direct creator showcase.
Project Zero adds a broad, unusual firearm roster including a G11, HCAR, Lahti L-39 and launcher designs. Current creator instructions name TaCZ 1.1.8.
Shooting Star is a Blue Archive-inspired shotgun with a creator-described pump action after two shots, making the handling concept itself distinctive.
Search & Recon uses paired energy-burst pistols, custom animations and scripting, a useful reference for asymmetrical magical gun designs.
JABoHME mixes unusual historical and modern firearms with fictional designs. The creator identifies it as a first pack, so it remains a discovery rather than an unqualified quality benchmark.
Meteorite Technology APX offers Titanfall 2 and Apex-inspired firearms with unusual science-fiction forms.
accepted.access: Free public edition; paid expanded edition
accepted.caution: The creator distinguishes a public version without attachments from a supporter edition. Gallery content is not a promise that every shown feature is in the free file.

accepted.reason: TWX Laboratory explores original science-fiction gun forms and associated equipment.
accepted.access: Free public trial; paid full edition
accepted.caution: The creator explicitly calls the public file a trial. Check the exact edition rather than assuming the full showcase is freely included.

accepted.reason: Genshin Impact Element Wars interprets fantasy-character motifs as firearms, with creator-described supporting script dependencies.
accepted.caution: The creator names Arcana and GunsmithLib requirements. This is a developing project, not a verified plug-and-play bundle.

accepted.reason: Fakelorant adds Valorant-inspired firearms as a real TaCZ gunpack, distinct from similarly named modpacks that simply distribute other mods.
accepted.caution: Recent creator instructions require TaCZ Fixlorant for this pack's custom recoil behavior; choose matching releases.

accepted.reason: SCP: Secret Laboratory GunPack brings a game-specific firearm roster and distinctive special-weapon presentation to TaCZ.
Eurrussia Variantz includes deliberately unusual Glock-derived fictional weapons such as Glompson, Glector and Glocket Launcher, alongside other firearms.
Black Paper's Modern Warfare 2019 Weapons is a distinct creator project, not a mirror of the other Modern Warfare-themed pack already listed.
accepted.caution: Creator instructions name TaCZ 1.1.4 or newer and LesRaisins Tactical support; use the exact file requirements.

accepted.reason: Blank Pack covers historical and experimental weapon ideas. Its version-port workflow is documented separately; no unlisted loader/version compatibility is inferred.
Xiaomantou includes actual additional guns, notably AX50 and XM556 concepts, despite its accessory-heavy summary. It belongs in the gun-content collection as well as the parent atlas.
Personal Defense Solution adds a focused service-rifle and carbine selection. Retained as an older reference with exact file dates visible.
Complete Silence focuses on sniper-style firearms. The creator discloses Chinese-only text and rough edges, so it is labeled as an experimental discovery rather than a polished recommendation.
accepted.caution: Creator-disclosed language and presentation limitations remain relevant; inspect its gallery before choosing it.

accepted.reason: PUBG HK416 is a specific creator model and handling reference. This older individual-gun pack is kept separate from unrelated HK416 projects.
HK416-A5 Gen3RD is a separate creator firearm model. The similar weapon name alone is not used to merge it with another author's gunpack.
PUBG AUG-A3 is an older, focused bullpup model reference rather than a recent broad gun-content release.
BF1 M1911 is a focused game-inspired pistol reference with source-model and animation credits preserved.
AK-105 is an individual creator firearm model with its own source gallery, useful for comparing compact rifle proportions.
ToxMav's Pack includes distinct tactical firearm configurations and models. Its creator-described model reuse is kept visible rather than presenting every component as original.
Huzai Gun is the creator's gun-content project, distinguished from the similarly named cosmetic-only Whimsy Pack.
Rin's Armoury is a small creator-authored firearm project, useful as an alternative presentation reference rather than a roster-size recommendation.
Cislumen Armory's AirTronic launcher experiments with deliberately exaggerated game fire modes and heavy weapon scale.
accepted.caution: The creator presents intentionally overpowered mechanics; do not treat the pack as a survival-balance recommendation.

accepted.reason: ScoredCupid's standalone AK-12 is preserved as a legacy creator reference with an explicit discontinuation label.
accepted.caution: The creator discontinued this standalone pack and notes possible issues with Endless Ammo.

accepted.reason: Menophage is a Destiny Xenophage-inspired fictional gun reference with a distinctive living-weapon concept.
accepted.caution: The source explicitly says this release is not compatible with TaCZ 1.1.4 or newer. It is a legacy inspiration, not a current-version installation recommendation.

accepted.reason: CS Zeus X27 adds a focused game discharge weapon with a single-shot cooldown identity, kept as a niche weapon-content reference.
Hui lin is an experimental character-shaped novelty gun with projectile effects. It is included for unusual fictional design, not realistic weapon quality.
Firefox Missile is an early novelty projectile-weapon pack, retained as a clearly dated design reference rather than a current polished release.
The Chinese War of Resistance gunpack includes creator-made Type 24, ZB-26 and MP18 models, a distinct historical theme.
accepted.caution: The author discloses rough animation/texture work and intentionally unbalanced game values. Planned firearms are not counted as included.

accepted.reason: Craftsman Gunblade is an actual published TaCZ gun-adding add-on: one item switches between melee and firearm modes, with a revolver-style reload and charged magical attack.
accepted.caution: Requires TaCZ and The four primitives and Weapons plus the creator-listed dependencies; do not install it as a standalone ZIP gunpack.
